resources.string: Today leads with the top four stories as a slideshow: swipe through, or let it turn every few seconds. Topics sit in the pills above; Curated, Newest and Oldest change the order.
Unfolded, Editrove shows the feed and the open story side by side, so you can read one story while you pick the next.
Full View gives the feed the whole screen as a magazine, and each story opens as its own full page. Switch any time.
Side rail ▭ button · or Settings › Appearance › Unfolded & Tablet Layout
Pull the page down: the line under the masthead names each source as it answers, and stories that are new since last time arrive under a New Since divider.
Stories open with their photo, a summary written on your phone, and the full text, even from many paywalled sites. If a site won\'t open, Editrove reads the same story from other newsrooms.
Short news videos from the outlets\' own channels, picked for the tab you\'re on. Top Stories mixes news, sports, tech, business and entertainment.
Tap a video to watch it full screen. Swipe up for the next one; sound, love, save and share are on the right. Tap the video to pause.
Love a story with the heart and For You learns what you like: four picks a page, five pages, worked out on your phone and never sent anywhere.
Your front page read aloud like a news broadcast, with a presenter you choose. Schedule a morning, afternoon or evening briefing.
News channels streaming now and radio stations from around the world, in your language or any other.
Columns, essays and the conversation around the news. Follow writers and topics with the + button, and get an alert when they publish.
Search every story and publisher, and see the top stories across all your topics in one place.
Tap the bookmark on any story to keep it. Saved stories stay on your phone and open offline.
Reorder or hide topics, create your own from keywords, change your city and country edition, and choose the newspapers each topic reads.
Pick the topics that alert you, and turn breaking news on. Alert sounds, quiet hours and a pause are all here; the same story never alerts you twice.
Black Glass or Editorial Paper, a comfortable text size, and the feed order you like.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your choices, loves and saved stories stay on this phone. Replay this tour any time.
Settings › User Guide › Replay the Feature Tour
